summary: Test drives a real enforced-auth app under root_path=/proxy (and via raw ASGI for /runners), asserting read tokens get 401 while write tokens pass on liveness + MCP GET/POST/DELETE; the read->401 assertion fails if authz classified on the full prefixed path. Adds root_path=/ parity and collision-prefix (/task,/runner,/m) boundary cases. No mocks.
